Hardware

List of the devices that I currently use and thus I can reccommend at least partially.

Most were chosen based on price-to-quality ratio where quality was determined by extensive online research, that is comparing "Best [device] in [year]" articles and cross-referencing them with Reddit reviews, and occassionaly asking friends to explain specs terms to me. This approach has yet to let me down.

Personal

  • Digital Audio Player (DAP): Snowsky Echo Mini
  • Headphones: Sennheiser HD 450BT
  • Phone: Xiaomi Poco F3

Computer:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor3.60 GHz
  • RAM: 16,0 GB
  • Storage: 477 GB SSD XPG GAMMIX S5, 894 GB SSD KINGSTON SA400S37960G
  • Graphics Card: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6 GB)
  • Keyboard: Keychron K10 Max
  • Mouse: MEDIA-TECH Vertic RF MT1123 V2.0
  • Microphone: SPC Gear SM950
  • Monitor: Philips 276E8VJSB/00 4K (yes I only use one monitor)
  • Speakers: I have some random speakers, I am not an audiophile and really can't tell the difference between cheap and pro speakers, don't @ me
  • Webcam: I have a random old webcam, not something I can recommend. I have little use for it outside of sporadic RPG videocalls.

Emergency

In Case of Emergency, my house always contains the following:

  • handful of AAA batteries
  • battery-powered flashlight: currently Lepro Penlight
  • battery-powered radio with LW: currently Eltra Asia
